children: Energy Transition Special Opportunities reported net income in the quarter, as interest earned on trust-account investments more than offset general and administrative expenses. The blank-check company said it has not begun operations and has no operating revenue, and is pursuing a business combination.
: Investments held in the Trust Account totaled $152.8M at September 30, 2026, including approximately $2.0M of interest income.
: The company continues to identify a target and expects significant costs for target identification, due diligence and negotiations.
: Cash outside the Trust Account was $647,771 and working capital was $428,235 at September 30, 2026.
: Management said available liquidity is insufficient for anticipated obligations through one year and plans to seek working capital loans or defer payments.
